infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Zami uses the camera for video calls, sign-in QR codes and photos you send.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Zami uses the microphone for voice messages and calls.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Zami shares your location only when you choose to send it.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Zami plugins use motion data for features you enable.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Zami saves the images and videos you choose to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Zami lets you choose photos and videos to use in the app.
